subject: WEEKLY REVIEW: Ammunition Stock Levels - 155mm Production Status
bodyPreview: Sir, Per your request, here is the weekly ammunition stockpile status as of 1 November 2025. Overall munitions readiness remains green with continued production increases...

body.content:
Sir,

Per your request, here is the weekly ammunition stockpile status as of 1 November 2025. Overall munitions readiness remains green with continued production increases.

155mm Artillery Status:
- Current monthly production: 28,000 rounds (up from 14,000 in FY24)
- Target production rate: 40,000 rounds/month by Q3 FY26
- On track to meet expanded capacity goals

Small Arms Ammunition:
- Production at steady state, meeting demand
- No significant supply chain disruptions

Missile Systems:
- Javelin: Production rate stable, inventory healthy
- Stinger: Modernization line operational at Raytheon

Ammunition Plant Status:
- All Army ammunition plants operational
- Lake City: Expanding capacity per plan
- Scranton: On schedule for modernization

Recommendation: Continue monitoring 155mm production ramp. Request quarterly brief to leadership on sustainment of increased production rates.

Respectfully,
BG Thomas Rodriguez
Commander, Joint Munitions Command
